newsitem.title: HUNGARY: STABLE PRICES, MODEST ACTIVITY SEEN ON HUNGARY MKT.
newsitem.headline: STABLE PRICES, MODEST ACTIVITY SEEN ON HUNGARY MKT.

text.p: Hungarian share prices are expected to stabilise with a slight negative tone on Thursday, traders said.
Traders said they did not see any particular external factors to trade on meanwhile the upcoming share offer in oil company MOL will determine investor's actions.
"Neither the Dow Jones, nor the dollar will show any direction," said Gabor Temesvari of Procent Hungaria.
The forint opened at 180.92/97 to the dollar, compared to Wednesday's close of 180.53/58.
Both he and an other trader said MOL shares might lose some ground.
"Demand will remain on the market but MOL may face some selling pressure," said Attila Berecz of Raiffeisen Securities.
"Domestic investors are waiting for the MOL issue therefore they might sell those shares on which they had already generated profit to invest the money in MOL," Temesvari said.
Elsewhere on the market, chemicals Borsodchem and OTP might attract increasing ahead of their annual shareholders meetings on Friday and Tuesday, respectively, traders said.
On Wednesday the BUX index finished at 5,840.65 points, up 37.39.
